transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’ve just been really tired. Not normal tired, I guess… like sleep doesn’t really fix it. Even small stuff, like unloading the dishwasher or trying to read for my certificate class, can feel like too much.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, like hobbies, work, or spending time with friends and family?
Yeah… I guess so. I haven’t really cared about the things I usually like—sketching, cooking, yoga. Even going to gallery openings or playing tennis with a friend just feels… not worth it lately.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?
I don’t know… maybe not “depressed” exactly. I’ve just felt kind of low and worn out a lot. Hard to say if it’s most of the day.
Would you say that most days, you feel down or sad for most of the day?
I’m not really sure. Some days I feel pretty low, but I don’t know if it’s most of the day.
Can you tell me if, on most days, you feel down or sad for most of the day, or if it's more that you feel low only at certain times?
I’m not really sure. It kind of comes and goes… I don’t think I’ve been keeping track enough to say it’s most of the day.
How long have you been feeling this way — about how many weeks has it been since you started feeling this low and worn out most days?
Maybe… around three months? It’s hard to pin down, but it feels like it’s been that long that I’ve been kind of low and really worn out.
Have you noticed a loss of energy or increased fatigue, even after resting or sleeping?
Yeah… that’s mostly why I came in. I’m tired in a way sleep doesn’t really fix. Even small things, like unloading the dishwasher or trying to read for my certificate class, can feel like too much.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in almost all activities, even those you used to enjoy a lot?
Yeah… I guess so. I haven’t really cared about the stuff I usually like—sketching, gallery openings, cooking, yoga. Even tennis with a friend just feels like… I don’t know, I don’t really want to.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or like you're not good enough lately, even about things that wouldn't normally bother you?
I don’t know… not really guilty, I guess. I mean, I get frustrated with myself, but I wouldn’t say it’s a big thing.
Can you describe what your mood is like during the day? Do you feel down or sad most of the time, or does it come and go?
I’m not really sure how to describe it. It kind of comes and goes, I guess… I wouldn’t say I’m sad every minute. Just sort of flat a lot of the time.
Do you feel down or sad for most of the day, nearly every day, or is it more that you have low moods that come and go throughout the day?
It’s more… it comes and goes, I think. I don’t know that I’d say I’m down most of the day every day. Just kind of low sometimes.
Can you tell me if, over the past few weeks, there have been days when you felt down or sad for most of the day, and if so, how often does that happen?
I’m not really sure. There might’ve been a day here or there where I felt pretty low for a while, but I haven’t been keeping track. I don’t think it’s most days.
Can you tell me if there have been days when you felt low or down for most of the day, and if so, how often have you felt that way over the past few weeks?
I don’t really know. Maybe a couple days where it lasted a while, but I haven’t been paying close attention. It doesn’t feel like it’s been most days.
Over the past two years, have you had days where you felt low or down for most of the day, and if so, how often has that happened?
Yeah… I think so. Not the whole two years, but this quieter low stretch has been around maybe three months. Most days I’ve felt pretty weighed down, I guess.
Over the past two years, have you had periods where you felt down or low for most of the day, more days than not, even if they weren’t every single day?
Yeah… I guess there has been a stretch like that. Maybe around three months now, where I’ve been low more often than not. It’s not every single day, but… most days, I think.
Over the past two years, have you had days when you felt low or down for most of the day, and if so, have those days added up to more days than not, even if not every single day?
Yeah… I think it’s been more days than not for about three months. Not every day, but a lot of them. Mostly just that quieter low feeling.
Over the past two years, have you had a period where you felt down or low for most of the day, more days than not, even if not every single day?
Yeah… like I said, it’s been about three months, I think. Most days I’ve felt pretty low, and just… heavy, not really interested in much.

inference_history.note: The patient endorsed symptoms of anhedonia, which is a key feature of depressive disorders. This makes F34.1 (Persistent Depressive Disorder) more likely in addition to the Major Depressive and Recurrent Depressive Disorder candidates. G72.81 (Fatigue) has been ruled out as the symptoms extend beyond a simple presentation of fatigue.

The patient reports symptoms lasting around three months, with low mood that comes and goes, and a loss of interest in pleasurable activities. This rules out F33.0 (mild recurrent depressive disorder) due to the duration and possible persistence of symptoms. F48.0 (neurasthenia) is also ruled out as the primary concern appears to be more mood-related rather than primarily fatigue or exhaustion from stress.

The patient reported a persistent low mood for most days over the past three months, which supports the inclusion of F34.1 (Persistent Depressive Disorder). The patient does not endorse feeling down "most of the day, nearly every day" with enough consistency to meet criteria for F33.2 (Recurrent Depressive Disorder, current episode severe). F33.1 (Recurrent Depressive Disorder, current episode moderate) remains due to possible recurrent episodes, but the pattern is leaning toward a more chronic, less episodic course.
